title: Performance Primer
scenario: Welcome to Performance Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Quality of Service (QoS): Mechanisms to prioritize traffic types. VoIP needs: latency <150ms, jitter <30ms, loss <1%. Tools: DSCP marking, CoS, LLQ (strict priority), shaping, policing. Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP): 6-bit field in IP header for Layer 3 QoS marking. EF (Expedited Forwarding) = 46 for VoIP. BE (Best Effort) = 0 default. Enables per-hop behavior (PHB) at each router. Class of Service (CoS): 3-bit PCP field in 802.1Q VLAN tag (values 0-7). Layer 2 QoS marking. Lost when traffic leaves the VLAN trunk — must map to DSCP for end-to-end QoS.
question: What does QoS stand for?
explanation: QoS stands for Quality of Service.
